description_html:
Key Features

  • Large Capacity: Equipped with a 916-litre drying chamber, this equilibrium-moisture storage silo is designed for high-volume storage and drying needs.
  • Efficient Moisture Removal: Removes up to 9 kilograms of moisture per day, ensuring optimal preservation of stored materials.
  • High-Temperature Operation: Operates at an air temperature of 87°C, supporting rapid and thorough drying cycles.
  • Batch Drying Cycle: Completes each batch drying process in approximately 5 hours, providing efficient turnaround for multiple loads.
  • Vacuum Airflow Pattern: Utilizes a vacuum airflow system to enhance drying efficiency and uniformity throughout the chamber.
  • Custom Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Improved Product Quality: Consistent moisture control helps prevent spoilage, mold, and degradation, extending the shelf life of grains, seeds, or other stored products.
  • Time and Energy Efficiency: Fast batch drying and high-temperature capability reduce processing time and energy consumption, lowering operational costs.
  • Reliable and Consistent Performance: The vacuum airflow pattern ensures even drying, minimizing the risk of uneven moisture levels or hotspots.
  • Flexible Storage Solutions: Large chamber volume accommodates substantial quantities, making it suitable for commercial and industrial use.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Grain and Seed Storage: Ideal for farmers, food processors, and agricultural businesses seeking to maintain seed viability and prevent spoilage during storage.
  • Industrial Drying Applications: Suitable for use in facilities requiring controlled moisture removal from bulk materials, such as food ingredients, powders, or pellets.
  • Moisture Management: Frequently used in environments where precise humidity control is crucial for product preservation and quality assurance.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is the silo easy to operate and maintain? Yes, the system is designed for straightforward operation and routine maintenance, with accessible controls and durable construction.
  • What materials can be stored? Compatible with a wide range of agricultural and industrial products that require controlled drying and moisture equilibrium.
  • How is pricing determined? Pricing is set after acceptance to ensure the solution matches the specific volume and operational needs of each customer.
